purpose: Compare final QA versus actual-reader raw material interfaces conditional on the same P02 upstream trajectory; not an end-to-end Raw method or pure-format comparison

population.exposure: existing formal subset; no unseen/independent-confirmation claim

selection.quota: largest remainder proportional; lexicographic type tie-break
selection.duplicate_group_policy: fail preparation if formal group_id duplicates

allowed: strict C1 migrated per-stage prefix bound to shared-layer main
upstream.historical_main_final_role: different-protocol reference only; no third new arm

prompt.protocol_effect: shared pre-frozen evidence-bounded interface, distinct from native four-shot final; prompt bytes unchanged
prompt.interpretation_boundary: Source visibility can interact with the fixed policy of treating generated answers as candidates, preferring relevant explicit sources in conflicts and abstaining on insufficient evidence. Estimate the combined interface effect under this policy; no assumption of neutrality or of which arm benefits.

QA.auxiliary: all ordered ordinary and goal request/propagated-answer records

Raw.auxiliary: all actual nodes[].reader_packet documents with per-node question and passage references
Raw.root_duplicates: reference R label; do not repeat body
Raw.auxiliary_labels: A1.. by first appearance in step_id then reader order

generation.overlength: hold pair; do not truncate, lower k, replace questions or select by outcomes
generation.normal_response: nonempty stop plus complete usage and correct model

completion.algorithm_failure_final: preserve zero on native scoring, including empty stop/length at full output cap; no score-driven retry
completion.technical_failure: hold missing; preserve other-arm response, receipt and cost
completion.upstream_algorithm_failure_without_compl: both arms upstream_not_evaluable, not two final algorithm-failure zeros
completion.missing_goal_or_reader: block pair, never render empty as substitute
completion.content_rejection: hold; no evasive input change or replacement
completion.identical_successful_payload_cache: strict exact reuse allowed; record shared receipt and logical attribution
completion.arm_order: hash-based alternating first arm per query, independent of outcome

analysis.primary: native Answer F1 QA minus Raw, equal mean across three datasets
analysis.missing: complete-pair conditional estimates plus fixed-100/dataset worst-case bounds using missing-arm scores in [0,1] and keeping observed-arm values
analysis.no_available_pairs_in_dataset: do not silently drop dataset from macro mean; report fixed-denominator bounds
analysis.null_interpretation: CI crossing zero does not establish equivalence or no effect
analysis.scorer: frozen native dataset scorers and aliases; no extra answer-cleaning patch

cost.actual_incremental: unique submitted new finals and failed attempts; unknown reserve separate
cost.logical_per_arm: same complete ordinary+goal upstream plus arm final; exclude unused main final
cost.local_decomposer_and_retrieval: report separate from API cost; do not invent GPU price

budget.basis: exact shared pre-frozen template plus old native trace length proxy; not shared-layer payload readiness
budget.refresh_before_execution: actual payload lengths and frozen price tiers; returned usage after execution

cost.alerts: inherit main historical 3x single-query and 1.5x rolling20 complete-fresh-flow policy; no extra hard cap

execution_blockers: qualified shared-main or C1-bound prefix for every executable pair; explicit status for all fixed cohort qids; unavailable upstream follows existing missingness rules
deterministic renderer and source-preserving escaping frozen
input/token/price-tier inventory and duplicate identity consistency
existing hold policy handled only by separately authorized execution
